PROGRADE TRAILERING SYSTEM myGMC MOBILE APP4
GMC’s available ProGrade Trailering System includes advanced technologies The available myGMC Mobile App4 allows you to create and manage trailer
for increased views and confidence. It helps when hooking up your trailer, profiles (shareable with other compatible Yukon owners), run a Trailer Light
while on the road and when backing your trailer into place. Sequence Test to help ensure trailer lights are in working order, reference
predeparture checklists and use a Trailer Load Calculator to determine the
combined weight of your vehicle and trailer. You can view and receive alerts
on key components of your trailer such as tire pressure monitoring3 and
trailer miles. There’s also a glossary filled with trailering-related materials.
OR
IN-VEHICLE TRAILERING APP1 SMART TRAILER INTEGRATION
The available in-vehicle Trailering App1 is integrated into the infotainment system2 The available ASA Electronics iN•Command® Control System5 is designed

name, trailer type and trailer hitch type. There are also maintenance reminders, compatible iPhones® and AndroidTM smartphones) or on the infotainment system
predeparture checklists, a Trailer Light Sequence Test, a Trailer Tire Pressure via Apple CarPlay®6 and Android Auto7 compatibility. The iN•Command Control
Monitoring System3 and a counter for trailer mileage and fuel economy. System allows you to monitor and control a range of smart system functions
such as water tank levels, climate controls and power slide-outs in recreational
trailers equipped with GlobalConnect technology.

23 HITCH STYLES
TRAILER HITCH STYLES
SELECTING THE RIGHT HITCH WEIGHT-DISTRIBUTING HITCH
Choosing the right hitch, while ensuring proper electrical connections are made, This is most often used for heavier trailering. This hitch type more evenly distributes
affects how your vehicle handles, corners and brakes, and allows you to alert the trailer load by using spring bars to shift some of the hitch weight forward onto the
other drivers of your intentions. Before selecting a hitch or trailering package, tow vehicle’s front axle and rearward to the trailer’s axles.
you should be familiar with the weight ratings specific to your GMC vehicle.
WEIGHT-CARRYING HITCH
This consists of a hitch ball mounted on a step bumper or draw bar, or a tow eye
latched to a pintle hook. Hitch balls are available in a range of sizes. Make sure
that the diameter of your hitch ball matches your trailer coupler. Also check that
the ball and ball mount meet or exceed the Gross Trailer Weight Rating.
